_README: Additional / curated sanctions lists loaded ONLY by scripts/sanctions-screen.mjs (not by the watcher's strict loader). A source may be remote (`url` + `parser`) or in-repo curated (`file`, parser 'curated'). Set `enabled:false` to keep a source configured but skipped. A remote source that fails or parses 0 names, or a curated list with no entries, degrades coverage (reported loudly) — never a silent all-clear.

sources.name: UAE EOCN — Local Terrorist List
sources._note: EOCN publishes this only as PDF/Excel behind bot protection — no free machine-readable feed. Maintain the names in data/eocn-local-terrorist-list.json from the official EOCN download (https://www.uaeiec.gov.ae). While unpopulated it flags 'coverage incomplete', never a clean result.

sources.name: Canada — Consolidated Autonomous Sanctions (SEMA, XML)
sources._note: Best-effort generic-XML parse; if the structure changes it degrades visibly rather than silently.

sources.name: Switzerland — SECO sanctions list (XML)
sources._note: SECO's official 'Gesamtliste' (overall list) XML, published since Dec 2023 at sesam.search.admin.ch and documented at https://www.seco.admin.ch/en/searching-for-subjects-sanctions. Parsed by the dedicated `seco` extractor (sanctions-match.mjs), which handles the nested <name>/<name-part>/<value> structure (unit-tested). Best-effort like Canada SEMA: the live fetch is verified on the first daily-screen run — if the host/format ever changes the screen degrades VISIBLY (opens a GitHub issue), never a silent all-clear.

sources.name: Australia — DFAT Consolidated List
sources._note: DFAT publishes the Consolidated List as XLSX (regulation8_consolidated.xlsx) at https://www.dfat.gov.au/international-relations/security/sanctions/consolidated-list — the current parsers handle csv/xml only, so this needs an XLSX→CSV export (or an xlsx parser) plus the confirmed URL before enabling.

sources.name: World Bank — Listing of Ineligible (Debarred) Firms & Individuals
sources._note: Debarment (not a sanctions designation) — a useful EDD signal for procurement-linked entities. Published as HTML/JSON at https://www.worldbank.org/en/projects-operations/procurement/debarred-firms with no stable bulk CSV; maintain as a curated file or confirm a machine-readable endpoint before enabling.
